Something else about the AV (the actual name of what we call KJV) is the full edition is a scholarly work in its own right with the full Apocrypha and coupious marginalia with internal references for Scriptural quotations by various writers including Jesus himself when quoting or echoing the OT. Where meaning is not clear, the marginalia offers elucidation or perhaps an alternate word/phrase. The editions most Americans know is a stripped down "student's edition" with only the Old and New Testaments and almost no marginalia.
